results.title: UK’s leader calls for reflection after the death of former Cambridge professor accused of plagiarism
results.description: Britain's prime minister has called for reflection after the sudden death of Jason Arday, a Black professor at Cambridge University who faced plagiarism accusations. Arday, Cambridge’s youngest Black professor, was found dead in London on Friday. He resigned last week amid media scrutiny over plagiarism and questions about his achievements. His death has sparked outcries over alleged racism and hostility toward diversity policies. British Prime Minister Andy Burnham on Saturday described the death as a tragedy. Arday's family claims he faced harassment and abuse. Police are treating the death as unexpected but not suspicious. Cambridge plans to review its hiring practices.
